item_name: Rothco ACU Digital "Booty Camp" Booty Shorts
item_short_desc: Rothco’s ACU Digital "Booty Camp" Booty Shorts offers the perfect blend of style, comfort, and functionality, making it ideal for lounging or as underwear. Crafted from a soft and breathable cotton / spandex blend, this loungewear set ensures all-day comfort and flexibility. The shorts feature the playful "Booty Camp" text across the back and waistband, adding a fun, stylish touch. An elastic waistband on the shorts provides additional stretch, ensuring a secure yet comfortable fit.
